SOURCES

Official source registry

Every official endpoint this project reads, what it authoritatively provides, and whether its values change over time.

Source policy

Only nfl.com and the official club domains are read, with one labelled exception: the published NFL Media Access Policy, which is hosted by the Pro Football Writers Association and marked as such in the publisher column. The build verifier checks every source link on every published page against the allow-list and fails the deployment if a row points anywhere else.
